statusGroups.reason: ADRs 0033/0038/0095: static Input queries and native SDL channel enable/sample lifetime execute with numeric Vector3 values and typed JoyMotionCalibration. Manual stationary bias, gravity filtering, disabled/focus zeros, mapping/ID retirement, errors and scene motion have public/native Linux Wayland checks. The independent 616-step C++ trace and prepared 0/0 owner/all-thread managed gates pass. Public and positive SDL/native strict NativeAOT checks also pass; full regression, hardware/mobile/foreign execution and native allocator limits are recorded separately in docs/components/gamepad-motion.md.

ADRs 0033/0038: Vector3 is an accepted numeric sensor tuple, so these are not 3D scene exclusions. The pinned Input.xml setters explicitly support debugging without hardware (lines 571-577, 602-616 and 649-655); input.cpp lines 753-799 and 1335-1356 use synchronized retained numeric fields. A connected manual value setter/getter slice is actionable on desktop without a mobile sensor adapter. Actual mobile acquisition/capabilities/permissions and delivery remain a separate host dependency; no such acquisition is claimed.
